title: RaSFNet: Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network for LiDAR Semantic Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2610.31186v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LiDAR point cloud semantic segmentation is a fundamental component of 3D perception for autonomous driving and robotics. Projection-based methods map 3D point clouds into 2D representations for feature extraction using 2D networks. However, aggregating multiple points during projection can obscure geometric differences within each frustum, while local feature extraction limits the modeling of spatial relationships across scanning regions. Moreover, proximity in the projected representation does not necessarily imply proximity in 3D space, and interactions between point and projected features may mix features from different ranges, reducing semantic discriminability. To address these challenges, we propose the Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network (RaSFNet), which incorporates point cloud geometry and LiDAR scanning characteristics into projection-based semantic segmentation. translated_abstract: 激光雷达点云语义分割是自动驾驶和机器人3D感知的基础组成部分。基于投影的方法将3D点云映射为2D表示，以利用2D网络进行特征提取。然而，投影过程中对多个点的聚合可能掩盖每个视锥体内的几何差异，而局部特征提取则限制了跨扫描区域空间关系的建模能力。此外，投影表示中的邻近关系并不一定意味着3D空间中的邻近关系，点特征与投影特征之间的交互可能混合来自不同距离的特征，从而降低语义判别能力。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了光线对齐与扫描感知融合网络，它将点云几何信息和激光雷达扫描特性融入到基于投影的语义分割中。具体而言，光线对齐几何分布编码器……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出RaSFNet，将点云几何信息与激光雷达扫描特性融入基于投影的语义分割，通过光线对齐几何分布编码与扫描感知机制，解决了投影聚合掩盖视锥内几何差异、跨扫描区域空间关系建模受限以及远近特征混淆降低语义判别能力的问题。
en_tdlr: RaSFNet incorporates point cloud geometry and LiDAR scanning characteristics into projection-based semantic segmentation, addressing obscured geometric differences within frustums, limited cross-scan-region relationship modeling, and reduced semantic discriminability caused by mixing features from different ranges.
